goal: Evaluate Shadow Xoah title: Agent of Destiny
body: Dave proposed 'Agent of Destiny' for Shadow Xoah. Treat as a working role/title, not canon lock yet. It fits existing shards: Shadow Xoah acts as temporal architect, enforces the causal stabilization path, remembers failed timelines, and intervenes so Prime reaches the required convergence. Key distinction for blueprint: she does not merely predict fate. She identifies viable destiny branches and acts to preserve or force the selected causal path. Explore Agent of Destiny as runtime archetype and system role.
